control_objective: Every emergency change to a financially-significant system is logged, retroactively approved, and subject to a post-implementation review, so that expedited changes remain governed even when normal pre-approval is bypassed.
risk_addressed: Emergency changes that skip normal pre-approval can leave unauthorized or defective logic in financially-significant systems undetected if they are not retroactively reviewed and approved, misstating the financial statements.

applies_to: Emergency production changes to financially-significant applications

required_data_elements.business_definition: A change recorded as emergency/expedited that bypassed normal pre-approval on an in-scope system.
The recorded post-implementation review and retroactive approval for the emergency change.

method.summary: Inspect all emergency changes in the period to confirm each has a post-implementation review and a retroactive approval.
steps: Pull all emergency/expedited changes for in-scope systems in the period from the change-ticket source.
For each emergency change, confirm a post-implementation review record is present.
Confirm a retroactive approval is recorded for each emergency change.
Count emergency changes lacking a post-implementation review and compute the retroactive-approval rate.
method.fallback_logic: If the source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any emergency change without a post-implementation review is a control exception; incomplete retroactive approval is a warning.
thresholds.pass_tolerance: 0 emergency changes without a post-implementation review
thresholds.escalation_threshold: 1 or more emergency changes without a post-implementation review

pass_criteria: Every emergency change has a post-implementation review.
warning_criteria: Not all emergency changes were retroactively approved by the time of assessment.
fail_criteria: One or more emergency changes lack a post-implementation review.
Emergency change population cannot be evidenced.
exception_handling: Chase outstanding retroactive approvals to closure.
Open a SOX deficiency issue if any emergency change lacks a post-implementation review.

assertions.description: Every emergency change had a post-implementation review.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter before §302 certification.
